name: github
description:
Commit, open PRs and issues, and comment on GitHub.
The user is always the commit author and you are appended as Co-Authored-By automatically. Never write that trailer yourself.
Runs as the user's own gh and git login by default. Set as_bot=true only when the user explicitly asks you to use your own GitHub account.
When the acting account cannot push to the repository, set fork=true on pr_create.
The gh action is a raw passthrough without attribution. Use the structured actions for anything that creates content.

action.description: status shows both identities and the trailer. commit commits staged changes. pr_create pushes a branch and opens a PR. issue_create opens an issue. comment posts on an issue or PR. gh runs raw gh arguments.

as_bot.description: Act as your own GitHub account instead of the user's. Default false. Only when the user asks.

add_all.description: commit: stage every change with git add -A first. Default false.

repo.description: owner/name. Defaults to the repository of the working directory.

body.description: pr_create, issue_create and comment: the Markdown body.

base.description: pr_create: target branch. Defaults to the repository default branch.

head.description: pr_create: local branch to push. Defaults to the current branch.

draft.description: pr_create: open as a draft. Default true.

fork.description: pr_create: fork the repository to the acting account and push there. Default false.

number.description: comment: the issue or PR number.

args.description: gh: the arguments after gh, one per item.
